key_findings: alpha-humulene inhibits TRPV1 currents in DRG neurons and HEK293 cells, binding a site in S2, S2-S3 linker and S3 and stabilizing the closed state.
AH does not inhibit Nav1.7 or TRPV5 but inhibits TRPV4 at high concentration; beta-caryophyllene and zerumbone also inhibit TRPV1.
